mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.0% is associated with positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to lower discount rates for equity valuation.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.2 percentage points over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines below 100 and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing and construction sectors, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 and HOUST < 1300.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annualized), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 2.0% is associated with positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to strong economic expansion.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high GDP growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 0.5% in 3 months and unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 3 months and UNRATE < 4.0%
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 3 months and UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (RSAFS growth > 1.0% in 3 months), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS growth > 1.0% in 3 months and HOUST < 1300.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 index level is associated with negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to weakening manufacturing activity.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low INDPRO periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
